$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). Presets are the maintainer's own address and public figures' published work addresses, never a private person's.

tasks.name: email-to-linkedin-profile
tasks.title: Email to LinkedIn: find the LinkedIn profile behind an email
tasks.description: Look up an email address and get the best-match public LinkedIn profile URL with a 0 to 100% confidence score and the evidence behind it: where the name came from and on how many platforms the handle was confirmed. No LinkedIn login or cookies. Replace the example with the address you are checking.
tasks.seoTitle: Email to LinkedIn - Find a LinkedIn Profile by Email
tasks.seoDescription: Find the public LinkedIn profile behind an email, with a confidence score and the evidence for it. No LinkedIn login or cookies. Bulk-ready.

tasks.name: bulk-email-to-linkedin-lookup
tasks.title: Bulk email to LinkedIn lookup for a lead or candidate list
tasks.description: Paste a list of work emails and get one row per address with its LinkedIn profile URL, confidence score and evidence, ready for a CRM, outreach or recruiting pipeline. Role mailboxes are skipped, possible matches below your gate cost nothing extra. Add a free Brave Search key to confirm more matches.
tasks.seoTitle: Bulk Email to LinkedIn Lookup - Lead Enrichment
tasks.seoDescription: One row per work email with its LinkedIn URL, confidence and evidence, for CRM enrichment, outreach or recruiting. Role mailboxes skipped.
